sections.accessReview: Dam crossing/portage unresolved: Upper Oconto Falls, Lower Oconto Falls, Stiles. A legal, usable route around the barrier has not been established. Do not plan this as a continuous float.
sections.routeReview: This section includes Upper Oconto Falls, Lower Oconto Falls, Stiles and needs a closer check of the landing or portage. Consult the agency guide and signed access; do not assume you can paddle through a dam.
